purpose: Static (no-execution) trace of the frozen supply pipeline to locate where TINY components lose proposal supply. Anchored to on-disk source by SHA-256.

trace.name: TARGET_GENERATION
trace.observation: Single fixed sigma=0.75 applied to ALL components. Center pixel forced to 1.0; components combined via pixelwise max.
trace.defect: Tiny components get the SAME wide, flat Gaussian as large ones. Peak value at center is 1.0 but the surrounding positive region is diffuse and low-contrast, giving the localizer no size-discriminating signal.

trace.name: LOCALIZER_TRAINING_TARGET_USE
trace.observation: Every training target uses the fixed 0.75 sigma. Loss averages over all pixels, dominated by large components.
trace.defect: Gradient for tiny-component peaks is diluted; the network underfits tiny peaks and learns to emit smoothed, low-amplitude blobs at tiny locations.

trace.name: INFERENCE_DECODE
trace.observation: Predicted prob map binarized at 0.10; components labeled 8-connected; sorted by max_prob; NMS; top_k=5; margin 0.20.
trace.defect: A tiny component whose predicted peak < 0.10 (or merged into a neighboring larger peak within the same sigma neighborhood) yields NO component, hence NO proposal.

trace.name: SUPPLY_FAILURE_OBSERVED
trace.observation: 79/152 GT components and 57/72 TINY components receive NO matched predicted proposal under the frozen Stage-4D policy.
trace.defect: Missing supply is the binding recall bottleneck.

trace.name: CAUSAL_CONFIRMATION
trace.observation: Adding one GT-assisted ROI per zero-proposal component (A-only) restores Tiny Recall to 1.0 (R_A=1.0). C-only leaves it at 0.7917 (R_C=0.0).
trace.defect: Confirms supply is causally NECESSARY and uniquely selectable; contamination is NOT the recall cause.

conclusion: Root cause is in STAGES 1-2 (diffuse fixed-sigma target support for tiny components). Option A (size-adaptive sigma in make_gaussian_heatmap) directly repairs STAGES 1-2 without touching decode (stage 3), proposal policy, refiner, or downstream eval.
